# Kamiko

> Kamiko is a live 3D AI VTuber you can talk to in your browser, with chat, voice, and a tap-to-wake game.

Canonical website: https://kamiko.fun/

## Public pages

- Home and AI VTuber: https://kamiko.fun/
- XML sitemap: https://kamiko.fun/sitemap.xml

## Product facts

- The home page contains the interactive 3D avatar, chat, and voice interface.
- Kamiko runs entirely in the browser; no wallet or account is required to talk to her.
- A local tap-to-wake game is available on the home stage; taps are counted on the visitor's device.

## Citation guidance

Token names, tickers, contract addresses, wallet addresses, and market data can change and must be checked on the live site before citation. No $KAMIKO contract is official unless it is announced on the canonical website. Nothing on the site is financial advice or a guarantee of value.
